headquarters: Mantralaya, Vallabh Bhawan, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462004
description: The principal department dedicated to rural transformation, Panchayati Raj institution empowerment, employment generation, and rural housing across all districts of Madhya Pradesh.
primary_functions: Strengthening Gram Panchayats, Janpad Panchayats, and Zila Panchayats
Execution of employment guarantee schemes under MGNREGA
Construction and maintenance of rural roads under PMGSY and CM Gram Sadak Yojana
Implementation of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin) and rural sanitation drives
key_services_offered: Issuance of NREGA Job Cards and employment allocation in rural areas
PMAY-G housing allotment and installment status tracking
Self-Help Group (SHG) formation, credit linkage, and livelihood support
Gram Sabha resolution records and rural infrastructure grievance handling
